reasoning: Each of the three cliques has size 3, covering only 9 vertices. The requirement that every one of the 14 vertices belongs to a clique cannot be satisfied, so no such graph exists.
cot_trace: We need 14 vertices, exactly 3 vertex-disjoint cliques each size 3. That's 3*3=9 vertices used, but we have 14 vertices, each vertex must belong to one of these cliques. Impossible because 14 not divisible by 3 and need exactly 3 cliques of size 3 covering all vertices. So UNSAT.
